title: CornerStone Acres Stables
specs: Indoor arena with Bluetooth surround sound and heated observation room
Groomed trail around property and access to 85 acres of wooded trails
Experienced instructors with police background checks and code of ethics
Ages 8 and up for lessons and camps
Riders must wear protective helmet (bicycle helmet acceptable initially) and shoes or boots with 1/4 inch heel
Deposit required for camps and rentals
No credit card payments; cash, Zelle, or checks accepted
Group trail rides require booking 1-2 weeks in advance with deposit
Scout clinics available for any size group
Summer camps limited to 6-8 riders per session, rider to instructor ratio 3:1

blurb: Guests can take riding lessons for ages 8 and up, participate in specialty rides including group trail rides, scout clinics, and field trips, or attend summer horse camps. The stable offers rental saddle seat suits and tack for equestrian teams. Facilities include indoor and outdoor arenas, groomed trails, and experienced instructors focused on safety and confidence building.
